content.text: The rising demand for the BAMS course is having a significant impact throughout Bihar, as medical colleges are making efforts to incorporate it into their Curricula. The Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery is a 5.5-year course that includes a year of on-field internship. There are a total of 10 colleges that take BAMS admission in Bihar.

The primary requirement for BAMS admission in India is a NEET UG qualification. So, it is mandatory to pass NEET for BAMS admission in Bihar also. In this article, the information related to the admission process, eligibility, and fee structure for the BAMS course in Bihar is described in detail.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission in Bihar Overview

content.text: The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test, NEET is necessary for BAMS admission in Bihar. The 12th passed out students must qualify for the NEET-UG to be able to attend the counselling session for BAMS. The Bihar AYUSH counselling is conducted by the Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB). All willing students have to register for the counselling to get BAMS admission in the available medical colleges. There are 600 BAMS seats in Bihar. Out of which 78 seats are in the two government colleges, and the other 522 seats are in private colleges. Candidates can choose their preference for colleges during the counselling.

sections.heading: BAMS Eligibility in Bihar

content.text: The following are the eligibility criteria for BAMS admission in Bihar. These criteria are being set by the State Ayush Counselling Board (BCECEB).
Academic Qualification

items: Candidates must complete 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as compulsory subjects from a recognised board.
They must obtain an aggregate of at least 50% in PCB subjects. For ST/SC/OBC, it is 40% and for PwD, it is 45%.

content.text: Entrance Test

items: Appear in the Nationa Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG) which is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA).
Score above the cut-off mark. Each year, the cut-off mark changes according to the NEET UG exam. The BCECEB publishes the cut-off mark each year before conducting the counselling session.

content.text: Age

items: Students who are willing to get admission must be aged 17 years and above as of the 1st January of the admission year.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission Process in Bihar

content.text: The whole process of BAMS admission in Bihar is given as a stepwise guide below. Follow it minutely to get a smooth admission experience.

Step 1: Appear for the NEET UG exam, which is conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA). The results will be available on the official portal of NTA. Visit and download the scorecard, which includes marks, rank, and percentile.

Step 2: The next step is to register for the counselling session. Visit the official website of BCECEB . Complete your registration by filling out your NEET UG Roll Number, Date of Birth, and Personal details (name, email, mobile number).
Step 3: Upload the required documents and pay the counselling fee online, and submit.

Step 4: BCECEB will release a state merit list based on NEET UG ranks. Candidates have to attend the counselling session. They have to log in to the BCECEB portal to select and lock preferred colleges and courses. Prioritise your choices based on the cutoff and seat availability.

Step 5: After being allotted to a college. Students must report to the college by the deadline. Carry all of your documents, both originals and photocopies, to complete the document verification through scrutiny.
Step 6: The Last step includes paying the fees to finalise the candidates admission.

There are 4 rounds of counselling conducted in the state of Bihar (Round 1, Round 2, a Mop-Up Round, and a stray vacancy round). If your seat is not allotted in a round, participate in the next round for BAMS admission in Bihar.

sections.heading: Documents Required for BAMS Admission in Bihar

content.text: BCECEB has published a notice that contains a list of supported documents required for BAMS admission in Bihar. The list is provided below.

items: Original Admit Card of NEET(UG)-2024
Original Score Card of NEET(UG)-2024
Passing Certificate / Marksheet / Admit Card of Matric/equivalent exam.
Passing Certificate / Marksheet / Admit Card of Intermediate/ 10+2 /equivalent exam.
Residential Certificate.
Caste Certificate.
All the certificates/documents are in the original as per the requirements of admissions in Private Ayush Colleges.
Six copies of the passport size photographs, which were pasted on the Admit Card of NEET(UG)-2024.
Downloaded print of the Online filled Application Form (Part A & Part B) of UGMAC (Ayush)-2024.
Aadhar Card.
Any other documents required (if any), such as DQ (PH) / EWS Certificate, etc.

content.text: If the certificates of candidates are in languages other than English/Hindi, the candidate has to submit their English version at the time of Counselling.

sections.heading: BAMS Course Fees in Bihar

content.text: The Ministry of AYUSH and the Government of India jointly agreed that the colleges can set their own BAMS course fees in Bihar. Although the private and government colleges fees are different, their infrastructure and faculty are promising. For a more detailed fee structure, the students should visit the official website of the college or connect with us.

sections.heading: BAMS Careers in Bihar

content.text: There are many job opportunities in Bihar for BAMS students. BAMS jobs in Bihar ensure the prospects of future students, such as the passed out, got posts like Ayurvedic Doctors, Physicians, Lecturers, Therapists, Medical Officers, Clinical Trials Coordinator, and Pharmacist. For those who want to pursue higher studies, there are a lot of opportunities for PG admission in Bihar. The colleges provide courses that align with the BAMS graduates. Interested students can select from MD/MS in Ayurveda, Master’s in Public Health (MPH), MBA in Healthcare Management, and various specialised postgraduate diplomas.

sections.heading: Conclusion

content.text: BAMS admission in Bihar mandatorily requires NEET-UG qualification. Students must attend the state counselling session of Bihar for admission in BAMS. A total of 600 BAMS seats are there in the state. Students from Bihar and other states can apply to the colleges under the state quota and All India quota, respectively.
